items.source: Invoke the RequestMapping handler method preparing a ModelAndView if view resolution is required.
items.translation: 调用 `RequestMapping` 处理器方法，如果需要进行视图解析，则准备一个 `ModelAndView`。

items.translation: 返回配置的ModelAndViewResolvers，或null。

items.source: A ConfigurableBeanFactory is expected for resolving expressions in method argument default values.
items.translation: 解析方法参数默认值中的表达式时，预期使用 ConfigurableBeanFactory。

items.source: Support for custom argument and return value types can be added via setCustomArgumentResolvers(List) and setCustomReturnValueHandlers(List), or alternatively, to re-configure all argument and return value types, use setArgumentResolvers(List) and setReturnValueHandlers(List).
items.translation: 可以通过setCustomArgumentResolvers(List)和setCustomReturnValueHandlers(List)添加对自定义参数和返回值类型的支持，或者，若要重新配置所有参数和返回值类型，请使用setArgumentResolvers(List)和setReturnValueHandlers(List)。

items.source: Note: This method is available for backwards compatibility only. However, it is recommended to re-write a ModelAndViewResolver as HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler. An adapter between the two interfaces is not possible since the HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler.supportsReturnType(MethodParameter) method cannot be implemented. Hence ModelAndViewResolvers are limited to always being invoked at the end after all other return value handlers have been given a chance.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法仅用于向后兼容。然而，建议将ModelAndViewResolver重写为HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler。由于无法实现HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler.supportsReturnType(MethodParameter)方法，因此无法在这两个接口之间创建适配器。因此，ModelAndViewResolver仅限于在所有其他返回值处理器有机会执行之后始终在末尾被调用。

items.source: If your application has controllers with such return types, please configure an AsyncTaskExecutor as the one used by default is not suitable for production under load.
items.translation: 如果您的应用程序具有此类返回类型的控制器，请配置一个 `AsyncTaskExecutor`，因为默认配置的实例在负载下不适合生产环境。

items.source: In contrast to the "cacheSeconds" property which will apply to all general handlers (but not to @SessionAttributes annotated handlers), this setting will apply to @SessionAttributes handlers only.
items.translation: 与适用于所有通用处理器（但不适用于带有 `@SessionAttributes` 注解的处理器）的 `"cacheSeconds"` 属性不同，此设置仅适用于带有 `@SessionAttributes` 的处理器。

items.source: Default is a DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer.
items.translation: 默认值为一个DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer。

items.source: A HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler provides better access to the return type and controller method information and can be ordered freely relative to other return value handlers.
items.translation: HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler 提供了对返回类型和控制器方法信息的更好访问，并且可以相对于其他返回值处理器自由排序。

items.source: Always return true since any method argument and return value type will be processed in some way. A method argument not recognized by any HandlerMethodArgumentResolver is interpreted as a request parameter if it is a simple type, or as a model attribute otherwise. A return value not recognized by any HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler will be interpreted as a model attribute.
items.translation: 始终返回 `true`，因为任何方法参数和返回值类型都会以某种方式进行处理。如果某个方法参数未被任何 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 识别，则将其解释为请求参数（如果是简单类型）或模型属性（否则）。如果某个返回值未被任何 `HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler` 识别，则将其解释为模型属性。

items.source: More specifically, the execution of the handleRequestInternal method will get synchronized if this flag is "true". The best available session mutex will be used for the synchronization; ideally, this will be a mutex exposed by HttpSessionMutexListener.
items.translation: 更具体地说，如果此标志为"true"，则 handleRequestInternal 方法的执行将得到同步；将使用可用的最佳会话互斥锁进行同步；理想情况下，这应是一个由 HttpSessionMutexListener 公开的互斥锁。

items.source: The session mutex is guaranteed to be the same object during the entire lifetime of the session, available under the key defined by the SESSION_MUTEX_ATTRIBUTE constant. It serves as a safe reference to synchronize on for locking on the current session.
items.translation: 会话互斥锁在会话的整个生命周期内保证是同一个对象，可通过由 `SESSION_MUTEX_ATTRIBUTE` 常量定义的键进行访问。它可作为安全引用，用于对当前会话加锁时的同步。

items.source:
If this value is not set, the default timeout of the underlying
implementation is used.
items.translation: 如果未设置此值，则使用底层实现的默认超时时间。

items.source:
In many cases, the HttpSession reference itself is a safe mutex
as well, since it will always be the same object reference for the
same active logical session. However, this is not guaranteed across
different servlet containers; the only 100% safe way is a session mutex.
items.translation: 在许多情况下，HttpSession 引用本身也是一个安全的互斥锁，因为对于同一个活动逻辑会话，它始终指向相同的对象引用。然而，这在不同 Servlet 容器中并不保证；唯一 100% 安全的方式是使用会话互斥锁。
